run_multinode_training: run multinode DETR object detection training with submitit on a SLURM cluster
submit_trainer_job: submit a Trainer job to a submitit AutoExecutor with GPU and node parameters
parse_args: parse command line arguments for multinode training including ngpus, nodes, timeout, and job_dir
checkpoint_trainer: checkpoint a Trainer instance to resume training from a saved checkpoint file
setup_gpu_args: setup GPU arguments from submitit JobEnvironment including rank, world_size, and output_dir
